args.message:
Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). 2.9.4 is the
patched release on the 2.x line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 → 2.9.4 (fix CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
- Bump `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Security
- fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). This repository pinned the affected 2.8.0. The fixed release on the 2.x line is **2.9.4**, which this PR upgrades to.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` (commit c8b8ab7878) passed.

2. **Bumped the pin** in `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` on a new branch, `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4`.
3. **Ran CI** on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — it passed.
